Rate of Levy Payable on Incoming and Outgoing International Calls
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the amendment of regulations under the Finance Act, specifically modifying levy rates for international telecommunications operations. It constitutes a regulatory change under existing legislation, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
